incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p95-p99-pulse exceeded thresholds in us-west-2 (p95 > 750ms, p99 > 2.1s). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/r/alerts/1773214560 :rotating_light:
Aisha (SRE): paging @Liam (oncall) — can you take initial triage?
Liam (oncall): oncall here, ack. joining bridge in 2.
Aisha (SRE): quick facts from the alert: p95 jumped ~6x at 12:41 UTC, sustained for ~4m, streaming stalls flagged on SSE connections, overall error rate small but tail latency worst.
Liam (oncall): running quick checks:
```
# quick promql
rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) by (le)
```
Liam (oncall): dashboard shows a steep step in p95 for the realtime route and a correlated rise in queue length on runtime pool-12.
Maya (Runtime): I see a canary deployment kicked off ~6m before alert for model-v2-quantized. It started receiving ~10% traffic.
Ravi (Product): that canary was supposed to be low-risk. any cache changes?
Maya (Runtime): yes, the quantized variant changes KV cache key layout (shorter keys) to reduce memory. Looks like we missed a cache-miss regression in the rollout tests. Miss rate spiked for prefix hits around the same time.
Jon (Support): any customer-facing impact yet? I have a ticket from a small integration complaining of repeated 504s at 12:43 UTC.
Aisha (SRE): impact snapshot: ~4% of requests > 2s, p99 at ~2.3s, retries up slightly, webhook retry queue increased. No major outage but SLO breach on realtime p99.
Liam (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) reduce canary weight to 0, 2) scale runtime pool-12 by +2, 3) enable fallback model for streaming sessions. Doing step 1 now.
Maya (Runtime): decreasing canary weight via rollout controller... done. traffic switched back to model-v2 (stable).
Liam (oncall): scaling pool-12 now: `kubectl scale deploy/runtime-pool-12 --replicas=6`
Aisha (SRE): also toggling prefix-KV-cache to legacy mode to re-enable previous key layout, this should reduce cache misses.
Maya (Runtime): legacy cache mode toggled. watching cache hit rate.
Liam (oncall): p95 dipping, p99 still high but trending down.
Aisha (SRE): streaming stalls trace: multiple SSE connections stuck in resume-state when KV cache miss + long quantized kernel coldstart happened. That combo was rare but can blow out tail.
Ravi (Product): should we pause future quantized canaries until we add the cache compatibility test?
Maya (Runtime): yes, rolling back canary and flagging a test gap. I'll open a follow-up PR for e2e that includes cache key parity and long-seq stall tests.
Jon (Support): I messaged the affected customer with a short note: "We detected increased latency for realtime endpoints between 12:41–12:48 UTC; we mitigated and rolled back the canary. We're following up with root cause and ETA for fix."
Liam (oncall): current status: mitigations applied, p95 ~210ms, p99 ~520ms and falling, no active paging needed.
Aisha (SRE): further actions before we close thread: 1) Incident doc stub (RCA template) — Aisha, 2) Runtime postmortem + test gap (Maya), 3) Customer follow-up note (Jon), 4) Canaries paused and new gating (Ravi + Maya).
Ravi (Product): I'll coordinate a short post with impacted customers and set an internal deadline for gate fixes.
Maya (Runtime): creating ticket INFR-7623 for cache parity test and INFR-7624 for canary gating.
Aisha (SRE): leaving a reminder to monitor for 30m. If p99 reverts to >1.5s, re-page oncall.
Liam (oncall): thanks — I'll stay on watch for 30m. Marking as mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations applied by @Liam (oncall) and @Maya (Runtime). Link to timeline: https://incidents.redwood.example/1773214560
Jon (Support): closing customer loop once RCA draft is ready.
Aisha (SRE): thanks team. filing initial triage notes in pager duty and closing channel when doc stub is created.
